mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes (indicated by declining industrial production), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses short-term discount rates, generating immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When annual consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation requiring central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL >2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), policy rate hikes compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS >4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
